actions.label: Safety DISARM
actions.description: Clears the safety-device ARM request. Overrides SB. Does not touch motors.

actions.label: Safety ARM 1/2: request
actions.description: Step 1 of 2. Then tap 'Safety ARM 2/2: confirm' within 10 s. Does not arm motors.

actions.label: Safety ARM 2/2: confirm
actions.description: Step 2 of 2. Starts the safety device's 31 s standoff if SW1 is ENABLE. Does not arm motors.
